simple.meaning: לָחוּם (lâchûwm) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, eaten , i.e. food ; also flesh , i.e. body.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לָחוּם (H3894) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 20:23, with occurrences in Job, Zephaniah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לָחוּם (H3894) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לָחוּם (H3894) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לָחוּם (lâchûwm) / H3894 is traced through Job 20:23, Zephaniah 1:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him.
I will bring distress on men, that they will walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Yahweh, and their blood will be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.
